faq.headline: Healthcare Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your healthcare site.

items.question: Can patients book an appointment online?
items.answer: A general form can collect a preferred visit time. The practice must confirm availability; a live booking system is not included.

items.question: Is there a patient portal or medical record system?
items.answer: No patient portal or health-record system is included in this website example.

items.question: Can patients send symptoms through the form?
items.answer: Use a privacy-reviewed process for patient information. A general website form should not be presented as an emergency or clinical advice channel.

items.question: What information helps patients choose a clinic?
items.answer: Clearly list the care areas offered, clinician qualifications, locations, opening hours, accessibility details, and how to contact reception.

items.question: Can patients send medical records or symptoms through the form?
items.answer: A general website enquiry is not a secure patient portal. Do not request sensitive health information through it; direct patients to a privacy-reviewed channel provided by the practice.

items.question: Can the website give medical advice or handle emergencies?
items.answer: No. Use reviewed, factual service information and direct urgent or emergency needs to the appropriate local care service.
